name: DentaJet series
summary: J3, J5 DentaJet and DentaJet XL: multi-material dental lab production.

page.description: Stratasys DentaJet series 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Multi-material
page.lead: Three PolyJet printers for dental labs: J3 DentaJet (up to three materials, countertop), DentaJet XL (two materials, 4 kg cartridges, high volume) and J5 DentaJet (up to five materials, TrueDent dentures and full-colour models).
page.footnote: Source: stratasys.com J3 DentaJet, DentaJet XL and J5 DentaJet pages, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: Multi-material jobs
features.text: Models, guides and gingiva masks on one tray.

features.title: Super High Speed (XL)
features.text: Up to 30 % faster for high volume (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Lower cost per part
benefits.text: Up to 67 % lower on DentaJet XL (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Low-touch operation
benefits.text: One technician can run several printers.

specs.label: Models
specs.value: J3 DentaJet, DentaJet XL, J5 DentaJet

specs.label: Build size
specs.value: Print area 1,174 cm²; max part 140 × 200 × 190 mm

specs.label: Layer thickness
specs.value: Down to 18 µm; XL Super High Speed 61.875 µm (aligner arches)

specs.label: Materials per job
specs.value: J3: up to 3 · XL: up to 2 · J5: up to 5 (each plus support)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: MED610-DSG Rigid Clear, MED620S Rigid Opaque, MED625FLX Flexible Clear, Elastico/VeroMagenta Flexible Pink, Vero White; J5 adds VeroVivid colours and TrueDent

specs.label: Regulatory
specs.value: TrueDent: FDA-cleared Class II and CE-marked Class IIa; MED610-DSG: FDA-registered and CE-marked Class I (per Stratasys)

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE, FCC, cTUVus, Industry Canada, RCM

page.applications_heading: From implant guides to monolithic dentures.

applications.title: Implant cases and surgical guides
applications.text: Clear, accurate guides with models and gingiva masks on one tray.

applications.title: Models and aligners
applications.text: Crown and bridge models and clear-aligner arches at volume.

applications.title: TrueDent dentures (J5)
applications.text: Monolithic, multi-colour dentures, partials and try-ins.
